scope: Where the Rust rewrite's structure still differs from the Go owner it ports. Known source-confirmed gaps only, not an exhaustive acceptance claim.

findings.finding: Some query privilege visits are collected in the executor driver instead of the planner's `visitInfo`
Restate (account policy lifecycle; overlaps Y01's lazy account loading)
Configuration consumers: TSO/router options, RPC concurrency, stream readiness/prewarm, idle recovery

findings.group: DDL: migrate responsibility before deleting implementations
findings.finding: DDL is submitted as jobs (`tidb-ddl/src/job_submitter.rs`); inventory any statement still outside the job path

findings.group: DDL: migrate responsibility before deleting implementations
findings.finding: No ingest (fast-reorg) backfill: it falls back to the transactional merge (`tidb-ddl/src/cluster_ddl/add_index.rs`)

findings.group: DDL: migrate responsibility before deleting implementations
findings.finding: Backfill is one sequential batch loop, not Go's reorg worker pool

findings.group: DDL: migrate responsibility before deleting implementations
findings.finding: Restate (DDL error identity and rollback classification)

findings.group: DDL: migrate responsibility before deleting implementations
findings.finding: A multi-schema change does not promote a sub-job's KV-disk-full pause to the parent job (Go `promoteProxyKVDiskFullPause`), and ADD INDEX / MODIFY COLUMN always skip the DDL-time ANALYZE that Go's `checkNeedAnalyze` runs when `tidb_stats_update_during_ddl` is ON (default OFF)
Foreign keys: distributed locking, physical cascade sub-statements, runtime stats
UPDATE/DELETE: retained handle metadata and chunk streaming

`enable_parallel_apply` decides clonability by `supports_apply_worker_clone` (refuses only CTE/CTETable/Shuffle) instead of Go's `SafeClone` over each operator's `Clone` (29 implement it; others such as BatchPointGet refuse, while PhysicalCTE clones), and never appends Go's `Some apply operators can not be executed in parallel` warning
IMPORT INTO refuses (`tidb-session/src/dispatch.rs`)
Other dynamic memtable providers; internal transactions in TIDB_TRX
Other cluster tables and pushed operators; memory accounting
Writes during non-public, temporary and global-index transitions
Two region-cache lifecycles (TiDB and the native client): coprocessor RequestSelector, store-health recovery, batch-scan follower reads

Pessimistic lock RPCs carry only key counts and time to the statement (`cluster_table_storage::PessimisticLockObservation`), not client-go's `LockKeysDetail`: `TxnCtx.FairLockingUsed`/`FairLockingEffective` and the `FairLockingUsageCount` statement/transaction counters `FinishExecuteStmt` keeps are never set
No versioned upgrade: startup knows only bootstrapped or not (`tidb-session/src/mysql_bootstrap`)
No TTL job/task manager (`tidb-ttl` has helpers only)
Runaway-query policy (the resource-group controller is installed)
No plan-replayer owner composed
The min-start-TS reporter lacks V2 recent-schema reporting and DDL-queue exclusion
No cross-keyspace runtime (null keyspace only)
Statement summary: normalized plan digests, encoded plans, RU/CPU/network metadata

`StmtNodeCounter` is counted at the wire (`tidb-server/src/mysql_connection.rs`) instead of in `executor.Compile` after `Optimize` succeeds: sessions without a wire (internal, embedded) count nothing, and a statement whose planning fails is counted
ADD PARTITION TiFlash readiness and rollback

The MPP coordinator lowers a hand-built single-fragment scan DAG and refuses every pushed Selection, TopN and aggregation, where Go builds the fragment/task graph from the physical plan (including disaggregated compute placement)
MPP coordinator registration/reporting; exact-epoch RetryRegions invalidation
PD router transport; primaryless member publication; readiness/prewarm; idle recovery
TSO dispatcher options and stream construction; RPC concurrency
No Cascades memo exploration/implementation in the production optimizer

SQL/PB signature construction and typed vector execution; Go's build-time argument casts (`WrapWithCastAsJSON`, `isnull`'s JSON-to-string cast) are applied per value at evaluation instead of appearing in the expression tree (and EXPLAIN) The planner's `BuiltinFunctionUsageInc` (`expressionRewriter.newFunction`) is not called: it needs the function's `PbCode`, which a planner-built Rust function only gets at pushdown resolution.
No `EMBED_TEXT` runtime or inference provider
Datum conversion: source/error taxonomy, unsigned table overflow, ANALYZE adapters
No lazy InfoSchema V2, schema-cache-size loader/evictor or InfoCache timestamp ranges
Session-state migration of DDL and hypothetical state
SafeTS topology; the standalone fallback path
BRIE statements are classified but never executed

The status port serves only `/status`, `/metrics`, `/settings`, `/config`, `/schema` and `/schema_storage` (`tidb-server/src/http_status.rs`); Go's other routes are absent: `/info`, `/info/all`, `/labels`, `/ddl/history`, `/ddl/owner/resign`, `/mvcc/*`, `/regions/*`, `/tables/*`, `/db-table/{id}`, `/stats/dump/*`, `/plan_replayer/dump`, `/optimize_trace/dump`, `/extract_task/dump`, `/dxf/*`, `/ingest/*`, `/tiflash/replica`, `/upgrade/*`, `/txn-gc-states`, `/debug/*`, test hooks
No DXF scheduler/executor managers composed
TopSQL: plan-digest attribution, DML write/commit attribution, CPU/RU profiling, reporter lifetime

A plain EXPLAIN prepares the plan but builds no target executor, where Go `buildExplain` builds it (`explainExec.analyzeExec = b.build(v.TargetPlan)`): the builder's side effects (index-merge and table-lookup telemetry, partition pruning at build) do not happen

The DDL scheduler, systable manager, history and MDL readers scan records instead of running SQL on `DdlSessionPool::sess_pool`; the bootstrap stages raw rows; accounts load eagerly where Go loads per active user
